builds.name: Reference: Armor and control
builds.goal: Reference for K'Sante: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A defensive melee controller who builds a pull, protects allies with dashes and isolates a target by sacrificing defenses in All Out. Compare tank and All Out states with actual lost defenses. Health/AD damage value must not silently keep defensive-form stats while calculating offensive-form output. Armor and a real Spellblade attack may preserve close fighting windows.
builds.summary: Armor and a real Spellblade attack may preserve close fighting windows.
testPlan: Kit question for K'Sante: Compare tank and All Out states with actual lost defenses. Health/AD damage value must not silently keep defensive-form stats while calculating offensive-form output.

Start with the early core (Iceborn if attack access is useful, otherwise matchup armor) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Armor and a real Spellblade attack may preserve close fighting windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: K'Sante strikes, damaging and slowing enemies in a short line.

On hit, grants a stack of Ntofo Strikes. At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in.

When All Out, cooldown is reduced. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Do not add another Spellblade item; Thornmail and Randuin are conditional purchases.

The route fails K'Sante's stated kit question: Compare tank and All Out states with actual lost defenses. Health/AD damage value must not silently keep defensive-form stats while calculating offensive-form output.
Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Do not add another Spellblade item; Thornmail and Randuin are conditional purchases.
Full cost 14,750 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Iceborn if attack access is useful, otherwise matchup armor. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Thornmail, Randuin's Omen, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.
coverageNotes: No numerical damage or survival adapter exists for this champion. Loading this proposal opens a manual test sheet, not calculated damage.
Source formulas remain in Champion kit. Symbolic values, unresolved tokens and helper records are evidence to inspect, not a certified executable simulator.
Legal source item/rune references were checked; retained map flags cannot prove every live-shop condition. Confirm shop eligibility, exact on-hit/on-attack rules and real proc cooldowns in game.

kitEvidence.formula:
K'Sante shatters his ntofos to Knock Back an enemy champion, dealing [80 / 115 / 150] physical damage, then dashes behind them and goes All Out for [15]s. If the enemy would hit a wall, they are Knocked Back through the wall and K'Sante strikes them again for [80 / 115 / 150 + (0.05) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] physical damage.

While All Out, K'Sante's Abilities are upgraded and he gains [(0.4 / 0.6 / 0.8) × 100]% Attack Speed, [50]% Bonus Armor Penetration, and [20]% Omnivamp, but loses [35]% max Health, [85]% Bonus Armor, and [85]% Bonus Magic Resistance.

K'Sante's damaging Abilities mark enemies hit. Attacking a marked enemy deals [12] plus [UNRESOLVED({ee18a47b}; see calculationRaw)] max Health physical damage and consumes the mark.

All Out: K'Sante's Attacks, Abilities and Passive deal an additional [0.01 + (0.0001) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.0001) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] max Health physical damage.

K'Sante dashes, gaining [70 / 112.5 / 155 / 197.5 / 240 + (0.135) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] Shield for [2] seconds. If dashing to an ally, the distance of the dash is significantly increased and the ally is also Shielded.

All Out: Cooldown is decreased by [50]% and dash speed is increased.

K'Sante raises his weapons defensively for [0.4]-@MaxDuration.1@s, becoming Unstoppable and reducing incoming damage by [25]%. Then, he rams forward, dealing [45 / 75 / 105 / 135 / 165] + [0.08 + (0.0002) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.0002) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] max Health physical damage. Enemies hit are Knocked Back and Stunned for [0.5]-[1.75]s (based on charge time).

All Out: Cooldown is refreshed. Deals an additional [10]-[80]% damage as true damage (based on charge time), damage reduction is increased to [70]% and dash speed is increased, but no longer Knocks Back or Stuns.

K'Sante slams his weapon, dealing [70 / 100 / 130 / 160 / 190 + (0.4) × Stat(1)[statFormula=2] + (0.4) × Stat(6)[statFormula=2]] physical damage and Slowing enemies by [80]% for [0.5]s. If he hits, he gains a stack of Ntofo Strikes for [6] seconds. At 2 stacks, he instead fires a shockwave that Stuns and Pulls enemies for [1] second.

All Out: Cooldown is reduced by @RCooldownReduction.0*100@%.
